summary: A student calls home late because the next morning’s class depends on overnight assistance.
realLife: Tomko recalled calling her mother late at night to stay at the dorm so she could sleep and attend class the next day.
gates: Overnight assistance is missing and the student has contacted a parent.
inGame: needs: a parent’s contact and overnight coverage for the student.

turns.what: A replacement arrives before the parent leaves home.
turns.pulledBy: The agency fills the shift and the student confirms it.
turns.writesBack: The parent can keep their own evening plans.

turns.what: The parent covers the night only.
turns.pulledBy: The daytime assignment is still open.
turns.writesBack: The student and agency must arrange the next shift.
